overloadMerges.note: Autoparse produced two overloads (one per doc syntax line) that differ only in whether the optional document param is present, and dropped the '>' param entirely on both lines because its name ('>') doesn't match the parser's identifier pattern. Docs describe one flexible signature: aTable, document, '>' and '*' are each independently optional ('>' only has an effect when printing to a document, but the syntax line without document still shows '>' as reachable), so merged into a single overload with all four params optional and '>' restored.

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table to print, or the default table if omitted.

params.name: document
params.description: Name of disk label document; if omitted, prints the current selection as labels using the current output form.
Do not reinitialize the current print parameters.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Prints labels using the data of the selection of aTable, either via the current output form (no document) or via the Label Wizard / an existing label document on disk (document specified).

constraints: Cannot be used to print subforms.
If the user cancels the Print job dialog box (when not suppressed), the command is canceled and no labels are printed.
